hints.title: Decoupled Row and Column Visibility
hints.text: A person looks independently to the right along their row, and downwards along their column.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Line-of-Sight
hints.text: For a 1D line of heights, traverse from right to left using a monotonic stack of visible obstacles.

hints.title: Equal Height Occlusion
hints.text: When a person can see someone of equal or greater height, the line-of-sight terminates after seeing them, but identical heights block further visibility.

hints.title: Bidirectional Monotonic Stack Implementation

complexity.notes: Each cell is pushed and popped from the stack at most once in horizontal and vertical scans.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inspecting all pairwise row and column pairs takes O(m * n * (m + n)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) 2D array stores visible counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles equal heights by popping the identical height after counting it, as future observers cannot see past it.
